approach: Move generated Windows base keyboard tables into a contracts subpath with families, key sets and mnemonic associations; add pure engine views (buildDefinedComboMap, computeOutputPicture, computeHandlingSet) that diff the carved IR against the starting point over the likely base keyboards; wrap them in one memoised studio hook outside D3 and feed the selected base keyboard to the KeymanWeb test pane by postMessage.

decisions.decision: Base keyboard data moves to @keyboard-studio/contracts/host-layouts (subpath only)
decisions.why: engine and facet-index need it and engine may not import studio

decisions.decision: New buildDefinedComboMap walker keyed on last vkey, all output kinds, AltGr equivalence set, uncertain for context/guards/raw
decisions.why: buildComboKeyMap drops deadkey/nul/beep rules and uses first vkey, giving false leaks

decisions.decision: Handling set computed as pure engine views wrapped in a memo outside D3
decisions.why: no diagnostics, so D3 does not govern it; testable against corpus
decisions.rejected: compute in projectWorkingCopyVfs or inside D3

decisions.decision: Single-value layout_family plus a combine-QWERTY+QWERTZ toggle in the carve step
decisions.why: only QWERTY and QWERTZ combine; stays inside an existing manifest step

decisions.decision: Market mapping ships empty; union-of-keys fallback
decisions.why: every entry must cite a source and none exist yet

decisions.decision: Test pane gets SET_BASE_LAYOUT postMessage into osk-frame.js; engine simulate gets optional fallback
decisions.why: the pane authors use is real KeymanWeb; engine baseLayout option is never read

plan.summary: Plan for spec 084: contracts host-layouts subpath, engine output-picture views, memoised studio hook, test-pane base keyboard; 5 stories phased one per conversation after PR #1854 merges
plan.key_finding: The test pane is real KeymanWeb in an iframe and the engine simulator ignores baseLayout, so base keyboard fallback needs a frame message, not a simulator flag
